falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern match would be invalidated because that pattern featured a sharp V-bottom with no retest of lows; a break below 4,800 would confirm this is not a similar structural bottom and the 76% pattern correlation is breaking down, forcing a pattern reclassification

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 25 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The BLOWOFF SCORE of 40 typically correlates with declining/falling volatility as selling pressure exhausts; sustained VIX above 25 would indicate fear is expanding not contracting, invalidating the exhaustion thesis and proving the blowoff reading was a false signal of capitulation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10-year Treasury yield rises above 4.75% while S&P 500 simultaneously trades below its 20-day moving average
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This specific combination would break the current macro regime where yields and equities have been inversely correlated; it would signal a stagflationary or growth-scare dynamic not present in the bottom_2024_aug pattern, making the 76% similarity structurally invalid as the underlying macro drivers diverge

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
